items.title: Kenny Davern interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 16, 2001 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: They played because they loved music. They loved the King Oliver band

ctx.x: That’s good, Wow. Who are the Salty Dogs?

Well it was made up of a group of guys who had the oldest traditional, longest lived traditional band going in New York City at that time, which was basically the Red Onion jazz band. They are a group of scholars, you know, I mean they taught, they were Columbia professors and stuff like that. And they played because they loved music. They loved the King Oliver band or they loved the New Orleans Rhythm Kings you see. And at that time I was going through a learning process, or re-learning, or un-learning process…
